name: ui-ux
description: Product-aware UI/UX Head Skill with local Product Packs and shared cross-product UI contracts.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and validate production interfaces with mandatory product routing, local Product Packs, and a shared local UI contract layer. Shared Product UI Rules cover navigation/wayfinding, forms/data entry, feedback/status, state/recovery, destructive/high-impact actions, accessibility interaction, responsive adaptation, motion, and content hierarchy/progressive disclosure. Product Packs specialize those rules for websites, dashboards, web applications, mobile applications, and WordPress plugin/admin UI without weakening accessibility, security, authorization, truthful-state, or data-integrity requirements. Persian-facing language validation is delegated to persian-writing.
capabilities: Route UI work by product type before design
Load scope-relevant shared UI contracts after the Product Pack
Design dashboards with local executive analytical operational monitoring CRM and admin modes
Design websites with local IA trust conversion content SEO accessibility and performance rules
Design web application product interfaces with local browser and workflow rules
Design mobile applications with local iOS Android and cross-platform rules
Design WordPress plugin UI with local settings onboarding diagnostics operations and Multisite rules
Route Persian-facing UI to required language QA
defaultPrompt: Classify the product, load its Product Pack and relevant Shared UI Rules, then improve it without breaking behavior.
Design this website or web application using the correct product-specific UI/UX rules and validate representative states.
Improve this mobile or WordPress plugin UI using its required Product Pack while preserving constraints.
